claim_boundary: diagnostic upper bounds only; exhaustive small-root oracle is not production candidate discovery

findings.conclusion: existing external mosaic path is appropriate and already wins complete artifacts
standalone direct cost was a false baseline; both external mosaic and same-pack semantic preconditioning lose to v0.28 solid-context marginal cost
even an oracle two-parent mosaic is far larger than target pack marginal cost; promoting the unavailable parent would not repair archive economics
external record loses, but semantic recipe preconditioning inside the already-required physical pack has positive exact measured headroom
real ~62.8 KiB marginal headroom exists, but selected roots span two current packs; locality-aware co-packing is the missing physical mechanism

multi-root representation is materially smaller, but mosaic candidate retention used an absolute 4096-byte copied-information floor that a 2048-byte target can never satisfy; attempt 4 should use a separately bounded target-relative mosaic contribution floor without changing inherited v0.28 delta policy

next_hypothesis: a placement-aware compiler should choose external mosaic only when marginally profitable, semantic in-pack recipe when it reduces an already-required solid record, or a dedicated <=4-root co-pack when cross-pack root placement is the sole locality blocker; small targets require a target-relative bounded contribution floor rather than the 4096-byte absolute mosaic floor. Cases with negative oracle headroom remain untouched.
